zh-CN.title: 小兜文件与文件夹分享
items: 小兜连接页清楚显示授权状态，分享前可确认发送对象和链接可见范围
聊天卡片更容易区分文件和文件夹，下载与打开小兜各有独立入口

en.title: Share Pocklo files and folders
items: See your Pocklo connection status and check the destination and link access before sharing.
File and folder cards are easier to tell apart, with distinct download and Pocklo actions.
